connector.name: Easyship
connector.registryDescription: Connect Easyship to compare rates, create shipments, buy labels, and track packages globally.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.easyship.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package easyship-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.easyship. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EASYSHIP_API_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Your Easyship API access token. Get it from https://app.easyship.com/connect/api
